messages.subject: For Ana Fonseca Nordang | ESG, responsible sourcing and stakeholder governance
messages.body:
Dear Umicore Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Ana Fonseca Nordang, Executive Vice President, People and Organization, ESG and P&T.

Umicore's position across critical materials, recycling and battery-related value chains places responsible sourcing, ESG governance and stakeholder confidence close to long-term competitiveness. Those priorities align strongly with the operating-side work I lead today in mining.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate integrates government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate multi-agency and stakeholder matters, translate external obligations into accountable internal owners, and support evidence-based follow-through across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement and technical teams. I also support governance around a major solar and battery-storage platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using physical operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this experience might support Umicore's ESG, responsible-sourcing, stakeholder or strategic-partnership priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Umicore.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
